# Path allowlist for scripts/ci/scan_content.py.
#
# Format: <rule-id> <glob>   (one entry per line; '#' starts a comment)
# Globs use Python fnmatch against the repo-relative path; '*' also matches '/'.
# An unknown rule id is a hard error. Prefer a line-level `scan-allow: <rule-id>`
# comment over an entry here: entries here skip the rule for the whole file.
# Every change to this file needs maintainer review.

# Root README documents the scanner and quotes an example injection phrase.
prompt-injection README.md

# Card, SSN and IBAN values are published test values, not real data.
